Avery —

Appreciate the clean redlines and the clear targets. Quick acknowledgement: we received the MSA redline + order form. I’ve started an internal read and I want to propose a short plan so we can hit your 3/28 timeline.

Plan (high level):
1) Legal review: I’ll route your redlines to Legal for section-by-section commentary; primary focus areas below.
2) Pricing ops: Monica to provide uplift pricing and model the impact of the 24-month commitment + true-up.
3) Contract QA: I’ll consolidate a single redlined MSA and a clean order form for DocuSign once we have alignment.

Key things I flagged on first pass (see attached sergio_notes_redlines.pdf):
- Term language (Sec 2): your 24-month ask is doable, but we need clarity on renewal auto-extension and early termination fees.
- Exhibit A sequencing: we should call out a bandwidth-of-record metric and a hard burst bucket cap to avoid ambiguity.
- SLA credits (Sec 5.2): your proposed language is broader than our standard cap; legal will likely counter with a three-strike escalation and a monthly cap on credits.
- Data retention (Sec 9.3): 24 months for audit logs is higher than default; we’ll need a short privacy/security note on retention/exports.

Monica — can you run a preliminary uplift P&L and confirm the max discount we can offer here (target deal economics)? I’ll loop Neha for legal commentary tomorrow AM.

Avery — expect a substantive internal reply by EOB Mon (3/22). If we can align quickly we’ll produce an updated MSA + order form for your review.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: INTERNAL: NovaGrid renewal — legal + pricing action items

Team —

Looping you both in to get this moving. NovaGrid sent redlines (see original from Avery). They want a 24-month term, 2x baseline capacity, quarterly reporting and a 24-month retention request for logs. Target signature week of 3/28.

Immediate asks:
- Neha: Legal review needed on Sec 2 (Term/renewal), Sec 5.2 (SLA credits cap & three-strike language), Sec 9.3 (retention). Please propose counter-language for each item and flag any policy conflicts (esp. retention + export). Also advise whether we need to surface KMS/HSM text for their security team.

- Monica: Pricing Ops — run scenario pricing for 2x baseline across a 24-month term with a recommended annual true-up and one-time implementation uplift. Provide: list price, proposed discount schedule (we can consider up to 12% discount if Legal can accept our SLA limits), and an expected ARR/ACV.

- Ops/Service: once pricing + legal are set, we need an Exhibit A that enumerates the baseline metric, burst bucket cap, reporting cadence, and measurement window. I can draft the initial Exhibit A template after your inputs.

Schedule: can we get first-pass legal language + pricing model by EOD Tue (3/23)? That gives us Wed to reconcile and Thu-Fri to prepare DocuSign.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby for questions.

Sergio

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Cole <avery.cole@novagrid.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: term tweak + capacity uplift (NovaGrid)

Hi Avery —

Thanks for your patience while we coordinated internally. Summary of where we landed and next steps:

What Redwood accepts (proposal):
- Term: 24 months, start 2027-07-01. We will add explicit early-termination language with a pro-rated fee (legal provided wording).
- Capacity: 2x baseline commitment with a defined burst bucket (10% of committed capacity per month). Quarterly reporting and an annual true-up (30-day window).
- Data retention: we can agree to 24-month audit log retention with the explicit caveat that customer-initiated exports are supported; retention is limited to logs only (no raw PII).

What we countered on:
- SLA credits: our legal limited the open-ended credit language. Counter offered three-strike escalation + monthly cap equal to 50% of the monthly service fee for an individual incident, aggregated cap over 12 months. Neha included suggested redline in the attached doc.
- Exhibit A: we prepared a crisp Exhibit A that enumerates metrics, measurement windows, and burst caps.

Attachments (for your review): Updated_MSA_NovaGrid_v3_redline.docx (combined redline from Redwood), Updated_Exhibit_A_NovaGrid.pdf (capacity schedule).

If this aligns, I’ll prepare a clean MSA and order form for DocuSign and send the envelope by EOD Thursday (3/25). DOCUSIGN: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

Action items for NovaGrid: please confirm acceptance of the SLA credit cap language and the burst bucket definition by EOD Thu so we can proceed to signature. If you prefer a quick 20-min call to walk through the redline, I can schedule one with Monica and Neha.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to closing this one out.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
